name: Sebang Global Battery Co., Ltd.
summary: Sebang Global Battery Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells lead acid batteries in South Korea and internationally. It offers automotive batteries; industrial batteries; motive batteries for use in golf carts and electric vehicles; and electric forklift batteries. The company sells its products through agencies, direct sales, and institutional delivery; and direct and local exports. The company was formerly known as Global Battery Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sebang Global Battery Co., Ltd. in September 2005. Sebang Global Battery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
